en.name: Sculptor
en.ability: You start knowing a player. Each night*, you learn the alignment of their most recent nomination.

revisions.v1: You start knowing a player. Each night*, you learn the alignment of their most recent nomination.

en.flavor: "The sculptor's hand can only break the spell to free the figures slumbering in the stone."  - Michelangelo 1501 A.D.
en.firstNightReminder: Point to a player. Place the SCULPTURE token next to that player.
en.otherNightReminder: If the player with the SCULPTURE token nominated today. Show the Sculptor an evil thumbs down sign if the nominated player is evil. Otherwise: show the Sculptor a good thumbs up sign. Remove the NOMINATED token (if any).

zh.name: 雕塑家
zh.ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一名玩家。每个夜晚*，你会得知他最近提名的玩家所属的阵营。

revisions.v1: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一名玩家。每个夜晚*，你会得知他最近提名的玩家所属的阵营。

zh.flavor: ‘只有雕塑家的手才能够打破魔咒解放沉睡在大理石中的雕像。’-米开朗基罗 1501年
zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒雕塑家，对他指向一名玩家作为他的“雕塑品”。
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果一名玩家的角色标记旁有“被提名”标记，唤醒雕塑家并向他展示大拇指向上或向下的手势。
